Module 3: Indicator Variables

This is a synthetic mock LMS page for Klierly extension tests. It is not real course content.

Coding a category

An indicator variable takes the value 1 when an observation is in a category and 0 otherwise. A categorical variable with c categories needs c - 1 indicator variables.

The category that receives no indicator is the baseline category. Every indicator coefficient is a comparison with the baseline.
